scope: CAP-040 legacy five-day forecast per-location transaction integrity
behavior_before: Forecast rows used an inner savepoint, but the success audit and post-write completion steps were outside that savepoint. A success-audit failure could abort the aggregate run instead of isolating the affected location.
behavior_after: An outer per-location savepoint now covers forecast persistence, the success audit, and completion steps. Failure rolls back that location before a sanitized failure audit, and later locations continue. Forecast natural-key upserts and whole-transaction ClickHouse outbox commit behavior are unchanged.
focused_test_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_weather_forecast_atomicity.py tests/test_forecast_error_redaction.py tests/test_weather_forecast_worker.py tests/test_weather_forecast_cli_scope.py tests/test_weather_cli_parity.py tests/test_worker_operation_map.py tests/test_worker_job_contract_inventory.py -q
new_regression: success-audit failure rolls back that location, records a same-connection failure audit, and allows the next location to persist and project
remaining_limitations: Provider parity, live delivery, legacy schedule reconciliation, runtime authorization, and MAN-CAP-040 acceptance remain open.
